user.title: Choose how to sign in
user.description: For the European OMODA JAECOO app only, not CarLinko. Choose the identifier registered to your account and how to authenticate. Signing in may disconnect the official app. Passwords and one-time codes are not saved; session tokens are stored locally. No vehicle command is sent during setup.

credentials.title: Your app account
credentials.description: Use the email or phone number already registered in the official app. The account password, if requested, is NOT the vehicle-control PIN and is never saved. For one-time-code sign-in, the next screen asks you to confirm sending the code.

data_description.country_code: Digits only, without +. For example, 44 for the UK. This does not change the EU backend.
data_description.phone: National format or a full +/00 international number. The country code must match; significant leading zeros are handled automatically.

request_code.title: Send a sign-in code
request_code.description: Press Submit to request one code for {destination}. Nothing is sent just by opening this screen. HA first completes the gateway's verification challenge. If delivery is refused, do not repeatedly retry; use a password sign-in or the official app. Resends wait at least 60 seconds and respect the server's rate limit.

otp.title: Enter your sign-in code
otp.description: Enter the email or SMS code for {destination}. This is NOT the vehicle-control PIN. Codes expire, so use the latest code. Select Send a new code only if needed; no code is sent automatically. The code is used once and is not saved.

discovery.title: Find your vehicles
discovery.description: A session has been obtained, but vehicle discovery could not finish. Submit retries vehicle discovery with that session; it does not repeat your password login or send another code. If the session has expired, cancel and start setup again.

vehicles.title: Choose vehicles
vehicles.description: Select which authorized vehicles to add. Each vehicle gets its own device and sensors. Only existing cloud snapshots will be read.

pin.title: Vehicle control PIN (optional)
pin.description: Save your separate vehicle control PIN to enable optional lock/climate commands later, or leave this blank for read-only use. It is NOT your account password. The PIN is not verified during setup; it is only submitted for an explicit command after you enable controls. It is stored in HA configuration/backups, which are not automatically encrypted. Change or remove it later using Reconfigure.

data_description.control_pin: 4–8 digits, including leading zeros. Leave blank to avoid storing a PIN.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The saved session for {destination} can no longer be used. Enter its account password again. This may disconnect the official app. The account identity, selected vehicles and optional PIN are kept; the password is not saved.

reconfigure.title: Change or remove the control PIN
reconfigure.description: Leave the new PIN blank to keep it, or select Remove saved PIN. No verification request is sent here. Entering a PIN explicitly clears the local safety block from a previous failed/inconclusive check: confirm the correct PIN in the app before retrying. Stored PINs are included in your HA configuration/backups.

error.invalid_auth: Sign-in was rejected or the session expired. Check your account credentials and that you use the EU OMODA JAECOO app. Do not repeatedly retry.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the cloud service. Check connectivity and try again later.
error.rate_limited: The service is limiting requests. Wait before trying again.
error.api_error: The service returned an unexpected response. No vehicle command was sent. Try again later or check compatibility with your app/region.
error.no_vehicles: No authorized vehicles were found. Check vehicle binding and account permissions in the official app.
error.invalid_email: Enter the email address used for your app account.
error.invalid_phone: Enter a possible phone number for the selected country code. International prefixes must match that country; extensions are not supported.
error.invalid_method: Choose one of the supported account and sign-in methods.
error.invalid_code: The code is invalid, expired or was rejected. Use the latest code; do not enter the vehicle PIN.
error.too_many_attempts: Too many rejected code attempts. Wait, then explicitly request a new code instead of guessing.
error.resend_cooldown: Please wait before requesting another code (at least 60 seconds, or longer if the server requested it).
error.captcha_failed: The gateway verification challenge could not be completed safely. No code request was sent. Try later or use password sign-in.
error.delivery_failed: The service refused verification-code delivery. Check the registered identifier, wait, or use another sign-in method. The SMS service may refuse automated clients; TLS verification has not been weakened.
error.delivery_unknown: Delivery could not be confirmed; a code may still arrive. Enter it if received, otherwise wait before explicitly resending.
error.invalid_country: Enter a country dialling code using 1–4 digits, without + or a leading zero.
error.invalid_selection: Select at least one of the discovered vehicles.
error.invalid_pin: Enter 4–8 digits, or leave the PIN blank. This is not your account password.
error.pin_conflict: Enter a new PIN or select Remove saved PIN, not both.

abort.already_configured: This EU account is already configured.
abort.vehicle_already_configured: A selected vehicle is already configured through another account. Keep only one integration entry per vehicle to avoid conflicting sessions and duplicate sensors.
abort.setup_expired: Setup expired. Start again to sign in.
abort.invalid_account_config: Saved account details are invalid or unsupported. Set up the integration again with the account used by the app.
abort.reconfigure_successful: PIN settings updated. No PIN verification or vehicle command was sent.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: Sign in with the same account used for this integration.
abort.vehicle_access_changed: The account no longer provides access to one or more selected vehicles. Check its permissions, or remove and set up the integration again. Existing settings were not replaced.

init.title: Telemetry, privacy and optional controls
init.description: Polling only reads cloud snapshots and never wakes the car. Enabling remote controls adds native Lock and Climate entities; using their actions or automations can physically unlock or operate the vehicle. Commands are experimental, require the correct PIN and permissions, and have NOT been validated on your car. API acceptance does not prove completion: check the Command status sensor and the vehicle. No MQTT acknowledgement or automatic wake is used. Start with a supervised test while safely parked. Climate duration must match a duration reported by your vehicle.

data.charge_depth_is_target: Charging depth is a verified target percentage

data_description.enable_location: Opt-in map tracker. Reads cached location without waking the car. Coordinates may be stale and are recorded in HA history/backups; disabling this does not erase history. Do not use it alone for security or automatic unlocking.
data_description.enable_charging_details: Additional read-only schedule/depth queries, at most every 15 minutes. Support varies by car; no charging setting is changed.
data_description.charge_depth_is_target: Enable only after comparing the raw charging-depth reading with your car's actual charge target. This only labels data as %, never changes the target. Requires charging settings reads.

error.invalid_interval: Choose a whole number from 5 to 60 minutes.
error.invalid_duration: Choose a whole number from 1 to 60 minutes. The vehicle must also report this duration as supported.
error.charging_details_required: Enable charging settings reads before interpreting charging depth as a target percentage.
error.pin_required: Save the vehicle control PIN using Reconfigure before enabling controls.
error.pin_blocked: Controls are paused after an unsuccessful/inconclusive PIN check. Verify the correct PIN in the app, then re-enter it using Reconfigure.

state.confirmation_timeout: Lock state not confirmed — check vehicle
